name: Turso
label: Turso (libSQL HTTP v2) — SQL over HTTPS
description: Official libSQL SQL-over-HTTP v2. POST /v2/pipeline and GET /health on the database origin https://<db>-<org>.turso.io. execute.sql maps sql → requests[0].stmt.sql with config type=execute. Handler: OfficialApiNode. auth_token is never logged. Edit api_spec.baseUrl; the engine cannot bind host.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. execute.sql POSTs the entire INPUT JSON (empty bodyFrom); include requests (array of pipeline ops, typically execute then close). database.health needs no extra fields. Do not put auth_token here. Example: {"operation":"execute.sql","requests":[{"type":"execute","stmt":{"sql":"SELECT 1"}},{"type":"close"}]}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'execute.sql' | 'database.health'.

schema.label: requests
schema.description: libSQL v2 pipeline requests array (execute then close). Or send top-level sql only. Example: [{"type":"execute","stmt":{"sql":"SELECT 1"}},{"type":"close"}].

schema.label: sql
schema.description: execute.sql statement. Wired to requests[0].stmt.sql. requests[0].type comes from config type (default execute). Example: SELECT 1.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Pipeline request type for execute.sql. Wired to requests[0].type. Config default execute. EXACT: execute | close.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (pipeline results, or empty health body).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: execute.sql | database.health.

configurationParameters.label: Database URL
configurationParameters.description: HTTPS libSQL database origin (from Turso dashboard). libsql:// and turso:// are normalized to https://. Required unless database_name + organization_slug are set. Example: https://mydb-myorg.turso.io

configurationParameters.label: Database name
configurationParameters.description: With organization_slug builds https://{database_name}-{organization_slug}.turso.io when database_url is blank.

configurationParameters.label: Organization slug
configurationParameters.description: Turso organization slug paired with database_name for the database host.

configurationParameters.label: Auth token
configurationParameters.description: Turso per-database token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Create: turso db tokens create. Dashboard database URL is not this token.

configurationParameters.label: type
configurationParameters.description: Default requests[0].type for execute.sql. Official execute.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
